name: council
description: A council of contractor-style expert reviewers for documentation, designs, plans, and business proposals — not code (see the code-reviewer plugin for that). council:it runs the four IT experts (security, standards, efficiency, infrastructure) and council:business runs the four business experts (operations, finance, strategy, legal), each converging one reconciled verdict. Add a flag to run specific experts only, e.g. council:it --security or council:business --finance. Supersedes the earlier council-of-claude plugin, which named each reviewer after a person (Tom, Mike, Pedro, Hector, Emma, John, Natalie).
